lines.text: Wind. Violet sits against the fence, sketchbook closed on her knees.

lines.speaker: rey
lines.text: Eh...{pause=0.4} found you. You're hard to find, you know that?

lines.speaker: violet
lines.text: The door was stuck. You had to push twice.

lines.speaker: rey
lines.text: Ha. Yeah. I'm not great at doors.
Pause. He sits a careful distance away. She notices the distance.

lines.speaker: rey
lines.text: Can I say something? You don't have to answer. Your drawing, the one with the... the tree with no leaves? It was really good. Like, good good.

lines.speaker: rey
lines.text: It was open on your desk! I wasn't trying to... sorry. Sorry. I should've asked.

lines.speaker: rey
lines.text: It's not fine, your face says it's not fine.

lines.speaker: violet
lines.text: ...It's a tree.{pause=0.5} {speed=18}It doesn't have to mean anything.
Rey opens his mouth to push. Stops. A beat.

lines.speaker: rey
lines.text: Okay. Then it's just a really good tree.
